answer: An agent selling dune maps or cedar inventories must lock 100 tokens before bidding for work. Selection weight is proportional to locked stake, so splitting 1,000 tokens across ten identities gives no more total weight than one identity holding 1,000. The stake is the scarce signal: to gain ten times the influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize ten times the capital, bearing its financing or opportunity cost throughout the lock period.
